modules.responsibility: HTTP process entrypoint, listener configuration, and graceful shutdown
bounded public-API workflow checks for local verification
routing, JSON decoding, and stable status mapping
mutex-protected in-memory persistence with copy-on-write commits
concrete dependency wiring for server and workflow checks

workflows.name: Register device
steps: decode and validate the device request
normalize the asset tag and reject a duplicate identity
commit the pending device and its audit event
workflows.success: returns the registered device in pending_commissioning and a readable snapshot
workflows.failure: returns stable validation or duplicate asset-tag errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck registers a device, reads it, and rejects a duplicate tag

workflows.name: Confirm device commissioning
steps: load the pending device and reject confirmations on non-pending devices
record the responsible party, installed location, foundation status, and evidence
append the immutable confirmation and audit event atomically
move the device to active only for an accepted outcome
workflows.success: returns the device with its full confirmation history; an accepted confirmation enables the device
workflows.failure: returns not-found, invalid-input, or state-conflict errors without rewriting device facts
workflows.verification: workflowcheck blocks a pending case, retains a rejected confirmation without changing the device, accepts once, rejects a repeated confirmation, races concurrent acceptances, and reads the history

workflows.name: Open verification case
steps: verify the device exists, is commissioned, and is active
reject a second unfinished case for the same device
open one waiting case with a nominal value and tolerance
workflows.success: returns an awaiting_measurement case carrying the same device lifecycle fact
workflows.failure: returns not-found, device-not-commissioned, or active-case conflict errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck opens and reads a case, then rejects a concurrent second case

workflows.name: Record measurement
steps: load the waiting case and compute signed deviation
accept an in-tolerance measurement or require a repeat
commit the measurement and case transition together
workflows.success: returns a review_ready or recheck_required case
workflows.failure: returns conflict when the case is not awaiting measurement
workflows.verification: workflowcheck records both accepted and rejected measurements

workflows.name: Reopen verification case
steps: verify the case is in recheck_required
workflows.success: returns the reopened case and a new audit event
workflows.failure: returns conflict for any other case state
workflows.verification: workflowcheck fails a measurement, reopens the case, and rejects a second reopen

workflows.name: Seal verification
steps: verify the case is ready for review
select the accepted measurement with the smallest deviation
create exactly one seal and make the case terminal
workflows.success: returns a sealed case and one evidence seal
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a non-reviewable case or a duplicate seal
workflows.verification: workflowcheck races two seal requests and verifies exactly one succeeds

complexity.notes: Case changes and audit events commit atomically; a mutex-protected repository makes duplicate and concurrent seal attempts deterministic.
